fullPassage: Vera couldn't wait for her car to get fixed, but that was going to require longer than initially expected. Unfortunately, that meant relying on the bus for her commute. To add to the cruel irony, it hadn't stopped raining for the past three days. It was already past 7 PM when she stepped off the bus, cold and soaked to the bone, having left her umbrella at the gym. Her place was just one block down the street, but it felt like ten miles in this weather. Her legs moved on their own, and suddenly, the Cups & Blossoms' bell was ringing above her head. The warm, floral scent wrapped around her like a blanket, but it was another kind of welcome that surprised her — a smile from the cafe owner, soft and unassuming. She was also polite enough not to ask why Vera looked so tired, which was appreciated. Vera now seemed to realize what she had truly needed. Just a friendly face to ease the weight she carried.

To add to the cruel irony, it hadn't stopped raining for the past three days. It was already past 7 PM when she stepped off the bus, cold and soaked to the bone, having left her umbrella at the gym. Her place was just one block down the street, but it felt like ten miles in this weather. Her legs moved on their own, and suddenly, the Cups & Blossoms' bell was ringing above her head. The warm, floral scent wrapped around her like a blanket, but it was another kind of welcome that surprised her — a smile from the cafe owner, soft and unassuming. She was also polite enough not to ask why Vera looked so tired, which was appreciated. Vera now seemed to realize what she had truly needed. Just a friendly face to ease the weight she carried.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 힘든 시기에 진정 필요한 것은 물질적 도움이 아닌 정서적 지지
det.analysis:
✅ ① What people truly need in difficult times is often emotional support rather than material help.(힘든 시기에 사람들이 진정 필요로 하는 것은 종종 물질적 도움보다 정서적 지지이다): 차 고장·비·우산 분실 등 물질적 불편 속에서 Vera가 깨달은 것은 'a friendly face to ease the weight' — 정서적 위안 ← 정답

② Cafes serve as important social spaces for people who commute by public transportation.(카페는 대중교통 이용자에게 중요한 사교 공간이다): 카페는 배경이지, 대중교통 이용자의 사교 공간이라는 주장은 글에 없음

③ Rainy weather reveals the hidden kindness of strangers in unexpected places.(비 오는 날씨가 뜻밖의 장소에서 낯선 사람의 숨겨진 친절을 드러낸다): 비가 직접적으로 친절을 드러내는 것이 아님. 인과관계 왜곡

④ Taking public transit instead of driving helps people discover new experiences.(운전 대신 대중교통을 이용하면 새로운 경험을 발견할 수 있다): 대중교통은 어쩔 수 없는 선택이었고, '새로운 경험 발견'이 글의 요지가 아님
det.tip: 요지 = 글 전체가 전달하는 교훈/메시지. 배경(비/차/버스) vs 핵심(정서적 위안)
